faculty.name: Rakesh Mohan Bhatt
faculty.summary: Studies migration, minorities, and multilingualism, focusing on language contact and code-switching in South Asian languages like Kashmiri and Hindi.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究移民、少数群体和多语言主义，关注南亚语言如克什米尔语和印地语中的语言接触和代码转换。

faculty.name: Jonathan Dunn
faculty.summary: Studies how grammar emerges and varies across populations through computational experiments and large multi-lingual corpora.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究语法如何在个体和群体中涌现和变化，通过计算实验和大型多语言语料库。

faculty.name: Susan Faivre
faculty.summary: Develops policies and instructional strategies for ethical and effective use of generative AI in the classroom.
faculty.summary_zh: 制定伦理和有效使用生成式AI的教学策略和政策。

faculty.name: José Ignacio Hualde
faculty.summary: Studies sound change, phonology, and historical linguistics of Romance and Basque languages through phonetic analysis and fieldwork.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究罗曼语和巴斯克语的音系学和历史语言学，通过音系分析和田野调查进行研究。

faculty.name: Tania Ionin
faculty.summary: Studies second language acquisition and experimental semantics through intervention research and syntax/semantics interface analysis.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究第二语言习得和实验语义学，通过干预研究和句法学与语义学界面分析。

faculty.name: Jonathan E. MacDonald
faculty.summary: Studies syntactic theory and inner aspect in Romance languages through comparative analysis and formal approaches.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究罗曼语系语言的句法学和内方面通过比较分析和形式方法。

faculty.name: Aleksandre Maskharashvili
faculty.summary: Studies syntax, semantics, and discourse using formal and neural approaches.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究句法学、语义学和话语学，采用形式化和神经网络方法。

faculty.name: Anna Mendoza
faculty.summary: Studies literacy and second language learning for adults through classroom discourse analysis and qualitative research.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究成人第二语言学习和读写能力，通过课堂话语分析和质性研究。

faculty.name: Silvina Montrul
faculty.summary: Studies second language acquisition, bilingualism, and heritage language learning through psycholinguistic methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究第二语言习得、双语主义和母语传承语言学习的语言学理论和心理语言学方法。

faculty.name: Scott Nelson
faculty.summary: Studies phonetics-phonology interface and computational phonology through model-theoretic and production models.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究音系学与音位学接口以及计算音位学，通过模型理论和生产模型。

faculty.name: Randall W Sadler
faculty.summary: Studies the role of technology, particularly telecollaboration and virtual worlds, in language learning.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究技术，尤其是远程协作和虚拟世界，在语言学习中的作用。

faculty.name: Ryan Keith Shosted
faculty.summary: Studies how phonetic principles shape phonological, typological, and diachronic outcomes in diverse languages using acoustics, kinematics, and aerodynamics.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究语音原理如何塑造语音学、类型学和历时演变结果，使用声学、运动学和空气动力学方法研究多种语言。

faculty.name: Karina Tachihara
faculty.summary: Studies how cognitive mechanisms affect language learning, particularly unacceptability judgments and semantic knowledge, using psycholinguistic tasks and machine learning.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究认知机制如何影响语言学习，特别是不接受性判断和语义知识，使用心理语言学任务和机器学习。

faculty.name: Aida Talić
faculty.summary: Studies syntax, comparative syntax, phonology, and syntax-prosody interface in Slavic languages through theoretical and empirical research.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究斯拉夫语言的句法学、比较句法学、音系学和句法-音系界面。

faculty.name: Yan Tang
faculty.summary: Studies speech intelligibility enhancement and computational modelling of speech perception in noise through signal processing and automatic speech recognition.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究噪声条件下的语音清晰度增强和语音感知的计算建模，通过信号处理和自动语音识别方法。

faculty.name: Anastasia Tsilia
faculty.summary: Studies semantics, syntax-semantics interface, and pragmatics through academic research and testing.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究语义学、句法-语义学接口和语用学。

faculty.name: Xun Yan
faculty.summary: Studies speaking and writing assessment, scale development, rater behavior, and test score use in educational settings.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究口语和书面语评估、量表开发、评分者行为以及考试分数在教育环境中的应用。

faculty.name: James Hye Suk Yoon
faculty.summary: Studies syntax, morphology, and second language acquisition, focusing on Korean and Japanese linguistics.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究句法学、形态学和二语习得，专注于韩语和日语语言学。

faculty.name: Melissa A Bowles
faculty.summary: Studies second language and heritage language acquisition through classroom and testing methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究第二语言和母语使用者语言习得，通过课堂和测试方法。

faculty.name: Salvatore Callesano
faculty.summary: Studies language in U.S. Latinx communities, sociolinguistics, and bilingualism through perceptual dialectology and social media analysis.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究美国拉丁裔社区的语言、社会语言学和双语现象，通过感知方言学和社交媒体分析。

faculty.name: Rodrigo Delgado
faculty.summary: Studies bilingualism and code-switching in Spanish and English, focusing on acceptability judgments and social variation.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究西班牙语和英语双语主义及代码转换，关注可接受性判断和社会变异。

faculty.name: Florencia Henshaw
faculty.summary: Studies second language acquisition and pedagogy, focusing on Spanish through technology integration and classroom instruction.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究第二语言习得和教学，侧重于通过技术整合和课堂教学教授西班牙语。

faculty.name: Javier Irigoyen-García
faculty.summary: Studies the representation of race, ethnicity, and class in early modern Spain through literature and cultural analysis.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究早期现代西班牙的种族、族裔和阶级的文学与文化表现。

faculty.name: Jill Jegerski
faculty.summary: Studies second language acquisition and online processing of Spanish as a heritage language using psycholinguistic methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究西班牙语作为母语的第二语言习得及其在线处理，使用心理语言学方法。

faculty.name: John Tofik Karam
faculty.summary: Studies Latin American-Middle Eastern connections in global cultural and political economies through ethnography and transnationalism.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究拉丁美洲与中东之间的联系在全球文化与政治经济中的作用，通过民族志和跨国主义方法。

faculty.name: Eduardo Ledesma
faculty.summary: Studies 20th and 21st century Latin American and Iberian literature and culture, focusing on avant-garde movements, experimental cinema, and the role of visual impairment in film.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究20世纪和21世纪拉丁美洲和伊比利亚半岛文学与文化，重点关注先锋派运动、实验电影以及视觉障碍在电影中的作用。

faculty.name: Mariselle Meléndez
faculty.summary: Studies race, gender, and the Enlightenment in colonial Spanish America through literature and cultural analysis.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究殖民西班牙美洲的种族、性别和启蒙时代问题，通过文学和文化分析。

faculty.name: Alejandro Ramirez Mendez
faculty.summary: Studies migration and diaspora in literature and culture through cultural expressions like literature, graphic novels, and films.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究文学和文化中的移民与流散，通过文学、图文小说和电影等文化表达形式。

faculty.name: Joyce Tolliver
faculty.summary: Studies narratives and rhetorical analysis of gender and sexuality in Iberian literatures and global Hispanophone writings.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究伊比利亚文学和全球西语国家文本中的叙事和修辞分析，关注性别与性少数群体研究。

faculty.name: Anna Torres-Cacoullos
faculty.summary: Studies the interconnections between literary modernism and silent film, focusing on metafiction and new storytelling genres in early 20th century Spain.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究20世纪初期西班牙文学现代主义与无声电影之间的相互作用，重点关注元小说和新叙事体裁。

faculty.name: Angelica Waner
faculty.summary: Studies Indigenous intellectuals and networks through print culture and archival research.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究土著知识分子和网络通过印刷文化和档案研究。

faculty.name: Georgia Malandraki
faculty.summary: Studies phonology and phonetics of Greek dialects through corpus analysis and fieldwork.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究希腊方言的音系学和音位学，通过语料库分析和田野调查进行研究。

faculty.name: Justin Aronoff
faculty.summary: Studies phonology and morphology in Austronesian languages through corpus analysis and fieldwork.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究澳大利亚尼语言的音系学和形态学，通过语料库分析和田野调查进行研究。

faculty.name: Pasquale Bottalico
faculty.summary: Studies phonology and phonetics of Italian dialects through corpus analysis and fieldwork.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究意大利方言的音系学和音位学，通过语料库分析和田野调查进行研究。

faculty.name: Savanna Brittlebank
faculty.summary: Studies phonology and phonetics of African languages through fieldwork and corpus analysis.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究非洲语言的音系学和音系学，通过田野调查和语料库分析。

faculty.name: Marie Moore Channell
faculty.summary: Studies phonology and phonetics of African languages through fieldwork and corpus analysis.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究非洲语言的音系学和音位学，通过田野调查和语料库分析。

faculty.name: Mary Flaherty
faculty.summary: Studies phonology and phonetics of African languages through fieldwork and corpus analysis.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究非洲语言的音系学和音系学，通过田野调查和语料库分析。

faculty.name: Dan Fogerty
faculty.summary: Studies phonology and phonetics of African languages through fieldwork and corpus analysis.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究非洲语言的音系学和音位学，通过田野调查和语料库分析。

faculty.name: Pamela Hadley
faculty.summary: Studies tone and intonation in Bantu languages through fieldwork and acoustic analysis.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究班图语系的音系学和语调通过实地考察和声学分析。

faculty.name: Fati Husain
faculty.summary: Studies tone and intonation in Bantu languages through fieldwork and acoustic analysis.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究班图语系的声调和语调，通过实地考察和声学分析进行。

faculty.name: Laura Mattie
faculty.summary: Studies tone and intonation in Bantu languages through fieldwork and acoustic analysis.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究班图语系的声调和语调，通过实地考察和声学分析进行。

faculty.name: Meaghan McKenna
faculty.summary: Studies phonology and phonetics of African languages through fieldwork and corpus analysis.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究非洲语言的音系学和音位学，通过田野调查和语料库分析。

faculty.name: Mariana Mendes Bahia
faculty.summary: Studies phonology and phonetics of Brazilian Portuguese through corpus analysis and experimental methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究巴西葡萄牙语的音系学和音法学，通过语料库分析和实验方法进行。

faculty.name: Ian Mertes
faculty.summary: Studies phonology and phonetics of African languages through fieldwork and corpus analysis.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究非洲语言的音系学和音位学，通过田野调查和语料库分析。

faculty.name: Brian Monson
faculty.summary: Studies tone and intonation in Bantu languages through fieldwork and acoustic analysis.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究班图语系的声调和语调，通过实地考察和声学分析进行。

faculty.name: Raksha Mudar
faculty.summary: Studies phonology and phonetics of South Asian languages through experimental methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究南亚语言的音系学和语音学，采用实验方法。
